frames.source: Pre-cached individual frames extracted from normalized spritesheet

generation.prompt: make me a medium sized sprite. animated on bts jin. having simple actions. idle, walk , sad and happy

readme.description: This ZIP contains cached, pre-optimized sprite assets for "Jin Sprite Kit". Includes 16 individual frames, normalized spritesheet (150x246 cells), and original source image. Generated from workspace: 1024x1024px.

files.frames/: Individual sprite frames extracted from the normalized sheet

usage.normalizedSpritesheet: Use for game engines that support sprite atlases. Frames read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Check metadata.json for actual grid layout.
usage.individualFrames: Use for animation systems that require separate frame files. Files are named sequentially: frame_001.png, frame_002.png, etc.
usage.originalImage: The source spritesheet as originally uploaded. May contain irregular spacing or non-grid layout.
